steps.en: OCMS spots cases where no individual director or partner can be identified
steps.id: OCMS mengenali kasus tanpa kandidat individu sebagai director atau partner
steps.why_en: Nothing decides whether an individual candidate exists; the company simply stays the recipient.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menilai ada tidaknya kandidat individu; company langsung tetap jadi penerima.

steps.en: OCMS picks due company hirer notices at the third reminder stage
steps.id: OCMS memilih notice company hirer yang jatuh tempo di tahap reminder ke-3
steps.why_en: Selection covers every due company offender, not only hirers whose individual candidates were not found.
steps.why_id: Pemilihan mencakup semua company offender yang jatuh tempo, bukan hanya hirer tanpa kandidat individu.

steps.en: OCMS sends the company number to the data source and gets current data
steps.id: OCMS mengirim nomor company ke sumber data dan menerima data terbaru
steps.why_en: The scheduled job is switched off in production and it is unproven that the data source is the one named DOS.
steps.why_id: Job terjadwal dimatikan di produksi dan belum terbukti sumber datanya sama dengan DOS.

steps.en: OCMS updates the company's latest address used for the letter
steps.id: OCMS memperbarui alamat terbaru company yang dipakai untuk surat
steps.why_en: The address update only runs through a job that is not scheduled in production.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan alamat hanya jalan lewat job yang tidak dijadwalkan di produksi.

steps.en: OCMS updates the company's latest name on the notice
steps.id: OCMS memperbarui nama terbaru company pada notice
steps.why_en: The name update only runs through a job that is not scheduled in production.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan nama hanya jalan lewat job yang tidak dijadwalkan di produksi.

steps.en: The third letter to the company uses the refreshed address and name
steps.id: Surat ke-3 untuk company memakai alamat dan nama yang sudah diperbarui
steps.why_en: Letter generation is manual only and delivery to the print vendor is blocked in production.
steps.why_id: Pembuatan surat hanya manual dan pengiriman ke vendor cetak diblokir di produksi.
